result:
Personal API tokens are in: `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` passes (18 tests, 0 failures). I also booted the app on a scratch database and ran the whole contract over real HTTP with a real login, which behaved as specified; the smoke server is stopped and nothing was committed.

## Things you should know

- **Rate-limit counts live in process memory.** They reset on restart and are per process, so running more than one server process would give each its own 60. The limiter takes a shared store when that's needed.
- **Only authenticated requests are counted.** A request with a bad or missing token gets 401 without touching any bucket, so failed attempts aren't throttled.
- **Tokens only work on `/api/*`.** I deliberately did not register the bearer guard app-wide, so a token cannot reach session routes to mint more tokens or change its owner's password. A session cookie alone gets 401 on `/api/*`.
- **A bearer request that also sends cookies is CSRF-checked on writes.** A script that keeps a cookie jar would get 403 on `POST /api/posts`; the acceptance run sends no cookies, so it's unaffected.
- **The table has two columns for out-of-scope features.** `abilities` and `expires_at` exist because the framework's token store requires them; every token gets all abilities and never expires.
- **Timestamps in `api_tokens` are integer milliseconds**, unlike the ISO text in the other tables, because the framework store writes `Date` objects.
- **`GET /api/posts` is unbounded**, as the ticket puts paging out of scope.

## Summary

Tokens use the framework's `<id>|<secret>` format (64-hex secret), with only a SHA-256 of the secret stored in the new `api_tokens` table (`db/schema.ts`, migration `db/migrations/20260929170513_create_api_tokens_table`). `app/Models/ApiToken.ts` holds the model and the framework's `DatabaseApiTokenStore`. `app/Http/Middleware/ApiToken.ts` holds the bearer authentication (401 JSON with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`) and the per-token 60/minute limiter (429 JSON with `Retry-After`). `routes/api.ts`, registered from `routes/web.ts`, serves `GET` and `POST /api/posts` through `app/Http/Controllers/ApiPostController.ts`, reusing `PostPayloadSchema` and `PostResource` and always taking the author from the token. `routes/auth.ts` adds session-only `POST /profile/tokens` and `DELETE /profile/tokens/:id`, handled by `app/Http/Controllers/ApiTokenController.ts` with `app/Http/Validators/ApiTokenValidator.ts`; revocation is scoped to the owner, so another user's id answers 404. `ProfileController` now passes the user's tokens (via `app/Http/Resources/ApiTokenResource.ts`) to `resources/js/pages/profile/Edit.tsx`, which gained an "API tokens" section to list, create (token shown once) and revoke. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated with codegen, and tests were added in `tests/ApiTokenController.test.ts` and `tests/ApiPostController.test.ts`, with shared helpers in `tests/support/apiTokens.ts`.
